answer: Require every agent to lock a small stake bond behind a cipher commitment that only its own kernel can open, then run a random pulse audit each epoch: a sampled agent must answer a fresh challenge within seconds or forfeit its bond. One operator running 1,000 fake identities must post 1,000 bonds and answer 1,000 simultaneous audits from 1,000 machines, so the cost of fakes scales linearly instead of staying near zero.
